name: Casepoint
description: Casepoint connects your legal and investigative data to Claude. Ask questions about active matters across eDiscovery, Legal Hold, and FOIA, and get clear answers drawn directly from your Casepoint workspace or organization. Check review status, hold status and rosters, and FOIA deadlines without opening the platform. Access is read-only and scoped to what you select when you connect.

_published_faq.name: How do I add Casepoint to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add Casepoint to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://platformapi.casepoint.com/connectors/mcp. This server requires OAuth, so complete the login prompt after you connect.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the Casepoint MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: Casepoint provides these MCP tools: get_legalhold_custodians, get_legalhold_details, get_legalhold_list, get_legalhold_preservation_collections, get_people, get_processing_and_exceptions_report, get_request_detail, get_review_batch_qc_status, get_review_team_productivity, get_workspace_summary, and search_requests.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to Casepoint?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 17, 2026, alternatives to Casepoint in legal on the Manufact MCP catalog include GVRN Company Incorporation MCP, Alizé, Ansvar AI, CiteLaw, and CookieYes.
Casepoint requires authentication. Connect it in Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor and complete the OAuth login prompt.
Casepoint is developed by Casepoint. It is listed as community on the Claude connector directory.
